free_tier.stated: Not counted against any storage quota. GitLab docs: 'Only the project's repository and LFS are included in the storage limit. The container registry, package registry, and build artifacts are not included in the limit.' The 10 GiB Free limit therefore does not apply to OCI blobs.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: No egress charge is published for gitlab.com registry pulls; anonymous pulls are served without auth beyond a JWT. Effectively unmetered for anonymous public projects.

tooling: ORAS / docker / skopeo / crane all work against registry.gitlab.com; rclone has no OCI backend but 'oras cp' + rclone covers push/pull. Public projects allow anonymous pull tokens.
chaining: Unlimited projects per namespace x unlimited namespaces/accounts x 5 GB per layer (generic package max file is 5 GB; container layers see the same class of limit). Since blobs are outside the 10 GiB project quota, a single free account can host arbitrarily many OCI layers. Compare GHCR (already known). The differentiator here is the explicit quota exemption, not the registry itself.
limits_note: Container registry storage is visible without published caps in documentation. Blob uploads use the standard Docker chunked protocol, where layer size is determined by user build configuration rather than documented file limits. Pushes require CI tokens, and public projects permit anonymous pulls.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose: a documented per-file cap. Requires CI or a token for push; anonymous pull works on public projects. registry

reliability_note: Storage is reported under 'reduce container registry storage' but no hard cap or eviction is documented on Free; the risk is administrative cleanup of dormant projects rather than quota enforcement.
